# Wisp

> A fast, fun web framework for Rust: file routes, `.wisp` templates compiled to Rust, form actions that work without JavaScript, optional browser reactivity, one binary. Built so apps take as few tokens as possible to write.

AGENTS.md is the complete, compact reference: read it before writing Wisp code. Every app has it (`wisp new` writes it; `wisp update-docs` refreshes it), and `wisp mcp` serves it and the docs to agents as tools. llms-full.txt is AGENTS.md and every doc below in one file.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyziedevs/wisp/main/llms/AGENTS.md): every syntax form, API and gotcha on one page
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyziedevs/wisp/main/llms/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md and all the docs, one file
- [Design](https://wispweb.dev/docs/design): routes, page logic, templates, components, forms, cookies, hooks, runtime, build
- [Client code](https://wispweb.dev/docs/client): scripts, runes, directives, client blocks, components, stores, router, islands, npm packages
- [APIs](https://wispweb.dev/docs/api): resources and queries, storage, endpoints, validation, errors, auth, webhooks, rate limits, streams, jobs, OpenAPI
- [Deploy](https://wispweb.dev/docs/deploy): binary, static, Docker, Cloudflare, Deno, Vercel, Netlify, Node
- [Embedding and tests](https://wispweb.dev/docs/embed): in-process tests, tower, axum, Lambda

## Optional

- [Website](https://wispweb.dev): overview, quick start and the docs
- [Token counts](https://wispweb.dev/docs/tokens): the same apps in Wisp and other frameworks
- [Examples](https://github.com/wyziedevs/wisp/tree/main/examples): demo app, JSON API, Wisp inside axum
